title: FPRC decision Santiago Lopes POR
text:
FOUL PLAY REVIEW COMMITTEE
DECISION
PARTICULARS OF OFFENCE
Player’s surname Lopes Player’s Santiago
forename(s)
Player’s Union Portugal
Match Portugal v Uruguay
Competition November Internationals 2025 Match Date 8 November 2025
SELECT: Red card ☒ Citing ☐
Offence Law 9.13 – A player must not tackle an
opponent … dangerously. Dangerous
tackling includes… tackling … an opponent
above the line of the shoulders.
Finding of Committee
In the 17th minute of the second half of the match, with Uruguay on attack, the Player infringed
Foul play determined? by tackling an opposing ball carrier in an upright and dangerous manner, resulting in direct
contact by his head with the opponent’s head, in the facial area. The Player was yellow carded
Red card/Citing upheld?
on the field by the Referee and that card was upgraded to a 20-minute Red Card by the TMO
(also acting as the FPRO).
The FPRC determined that there was foul play by the Player – a breach of Law 9.13 and that the
Red Card should be, and is, upheld.
The Player initially was in a semi-crouched position as he led into the tackle, but rose upwards
immediately before contact, thereby making contact directly to the face of the opponent with
some force.
Summary of Sanction
Starting point: such a tackle involving, as it did, head contact “shall result in at least a mid-range
sanction”. Mid- range sanction warranted on the facts here, but not any higher.
Mitigating features were found present, and no aggravating factors.
Discount allowed at 33% given the factors listed in Reasons below.
So, from a starting point of a suspension for 6 weeks/matches, a reduction to 4 weeks. The
Committee grants the Player permission to apply for WR’s Coaching Intervention Sanction
Mitigation (CISM), and should he successfully complete the CISM, a reduction of a further
week/match will be applied.
Matches/tournaments
All rugby (whether XVs or 7s, and including all internationals and club fixtures) from 8
included in sanction
November 2025 up to and including 30 November 2025, if successful completion of the CISM
(including internationals Portugal v Hong Kong, Portugal v Canada, RC Montemor v Cascais (1st
Round, Honra Top 12) and any club matches in that period); should he not successfully
complete the CISM, all matches up to and including 7 December 2025 (which would then
include Wolves v Lusitanos and any other club matches in that additional period).
251110 FPRC Disciplinary Decision - Santiago Lopes (Portugal) Page 1 of 2

REASONS FOR DECISION
1. The Player rising upwards when entering and initiating contact.
2. Contact direct to the opponent’s head.
3. No HIA required; although a cut to eyelid which was sutured later, without further
complications.
4. Immediate acceptance of responsibility; and apology made to opponent.
5. Not a clear disciplinary record. – 1 previous red card in 2024, but not relating to a dangerous
tackle.
6. Allowing a 33% discount – from a 6-week starting point down to a 4-match suspension from all
rugby, whether internationals or club, XVs or 7s.
7. The Player is eligible to apply to WR for the application of the CISM which, if successfully
completed, would reduce the suspension to 3 matches.
Nigel Hampton KC, chair (New Zealand)
Foul Play Review
John Langford, former international player (Australia)
Committee Members
Leon Lloyd, former international player (England)
Signature Nigel Hampton KC Date 9 November 2025
Chair
Accepted by Player ☒
Proposed sanction
Not accepted by Player ☐
